{{Youmayd|the smuggler|Mynock|[[Mynock (disambiguation)]]}}
A [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who used the pseudonym '''Mynock''' was a supporter of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], and often served as an intermediary between the Alliance and other independent [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]]. "Mynock" worked from a base on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Calamari]], often from the [[Fathoms]] restaurant.
